stem.text: The diagram shows a steel wire clamped at one end. The other end is attached to a weight hanging over a pulley.

stem.alt: Steel wire clamped to a fixed stand at the left, passing over a pulley at the right to a hanging weight, with a vibrator on the base near the clamped end and a fixed support under the wire. Labels: fixed stand, vibrator, fixed support, weight.

stem.text: A vibrator is attached to the wire near the clamped end. A stationary wave with one loop is produced. The frequency of the vibrator is $f$.
Which frequency should be used to produce a stationary wave with two loops?
